role: market proxy for PREREG_003.md section 7.5's beta regression
rationale: Section 7.5 says 'market excess returns' and names no index. SPY is the cap-weighted US market and the literal reading of section 8's 'market beta'. It is external to the universe being tested, which the equal-weight benchmark is not.
alternative_reported_alongside: equal-weight buy-and-hold of the same universe, the construction experiment 002's factor_attribution used
